q1_issues.issue: "Midsummer" is a capitalized named time/festival, i.e. a proper noun, but no (Name midsummer "Midsummer") atom is emitted, and Names and casing makes that atom mandatory and non-optional for a named event.

q2_gaps: vague frequency adverb ("often") with no named slot, period or rate — Frequency & habitual schedules covers only a named Time slot, (Every e n unit) and (TimesPer e n unit), so an unquantified recurrence has no form

approximation hedge ("around") over a non-numeric named/deictic time — the approximate-time form (ParticleFromNormal inside Hour/Minute) needs a numeric magnitude slot that a bare named-time symbol does not have
notes: The dropped "often" and "around" are gap-driven rather than parse defects. CardinalityPhrase "many" is the right route here (the phrase counts things, and there is no kind-predication whose strength it could set), and Time on the group of event-denoting "parties" is the only anchor the instruction set offers.
